item.title: Gemma 4's MTP Drafter, Explained: Speculative Decoding and a 4-Bit Drafter at 60% of the Size
item.description:
发表方：dev.to (gde)　发布：2026-10-15　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

解析 Gemma 4 的 MTP 草稿模型与推测解码机制：4-bit 量化、体积缩减 60% 的 drafter 工程实现。

This article provides a step by step introduction to speculative decoding with Gemma 4's multi-token prediction (MTP) drafter, served by llama.cpp on a local, desktop hosted GPU enabled system. It is the first of a short series: this part explains what the drafter is and why you would use it, and the next part has the measurements.

https://github.com/xbill9/gemma4-dev/tree/main/local-llamacpp-3050oem-2b-q4_0

Gemma 4 ships a small companion model for every size, a drafter that guesses the next few tokens so the main model can check them in one pass. Google's QAT drafters are trained onto a 4-bit grid; stored that way they shrink from 97.8 MB to 59.2 MB and are published on Hugging Face.

What is this project trying to Do?

The rigs in this repository serve Gemma 4 E2B and E4B from local hardware: an RTX 3050 OEM in a desktop and a GTX 1650 Ti in a laptop. Both already run the exact 4-bit QAT builds of the main models. Google also publishes a drafter for each Gemma 4 model, and llama.cpp can now run it.

…

item.title: Gemma 4 on a Used 8 GB RTX 3050: 116 Tokens/s for One User, 618 for 64
item.description:
发表方：dev.to (gde)　发布：2026-10-15　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

二手 8GB RTX 3050 实测 Gemma 4 单用户 116 tok/s、64 用户批 618 tok/s 的消费级硬件边缘部署实测。

This article provides a step by step deployment guide for Gemma 4 E2B and E4B to a local, desktop hosted GPU enabled system: an RTX 3050 OEM with 8 GB, in a 2014-era Haswell-E desktop. A suite of Python MCP tools is built to simplify management of the llama.cpp hosted deployment.

https://github.com/xbill9/gemma4-dev/tree/main/local-llamacpp-3050oem-2b-q4_0

A used RTX 3050 OEM, listed at $179.97, serves Gemma 4 E2B at 116 tokens per second for one user and 618 tokens per second across 64 users, with the model's full 131,072-token context in 3.6 GB of its 8 GB. Against an AWS T4 on demand, the card costs as much as 342 hours of rental.

What is this project trying to Do?

Earlier rigs in this repository served Gemma 4 from rented TPUs and GPUs, and from hardware already on the desk: a 2021 laptop with a 4 GB GTX 1650 Ti, its CPU, and two Snapdragon ARM laptops. This rig asks what the cheapest dedicated card adds. The RTX 3050 OEM is an 8 GB Ampere card with tensor cores, and used ones were listed on eBay at about $145 to $210 on 2026-10-14.

…

item.title: Multi-Turn Memory, Mixed Precision, and Safer Rollouts — Serving Catches Up to Agentic Workloads (LLM Inference Digest)
item.description:
发表方：dev.to (Felipe 0liveira)　发布：2026-10-14　分类：技术博客

LLM 推理周报（10-07~10-14），汇总 arXiv/vLLM/HF/Modal 等动态；二手汇编，主要原始来源已另行收录。

This edition of the LLM Inference Digest covers new developments from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-14 across arXiv, the vLLM and Hugging Face blogs, Together AI, Modal, and Latent Space.

🔥 Highlights

- Improve TTFT for Multi-Turn Agentic Workloads with Bi-Directional KV Transfer in vLLM — lets decode nodes hand KV blocks back to prefill

- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on vLLM: 5x Agentic Throughput Since Day 0 — three kernel tricks, 5.3x throughput under TPS limits

- Endpoint Candidates: evaluate and promote inference endpoints — built-in traffic-mirrored canarying for serving changes

- Vesta: Queueing-Aware LLM Scheduling for Real-World Workloads — balances cache locality vs. queueing, cuts TTFT sharply

- Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B — sparse MoE hits 21K tok/s on one GPU

arXiv (cs.LG, cs.DC)
